|game_text=If your character’s forfeit was just reduced to 0, use 1 Force (free if forfeit reduced by a [Permanent Weapon] weapon) to restore it to normal. (Immune to [[Sense]].) * '''Original''' ([[Lana Dobreed & Sacrifice (Virtual Block 6)]]): Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV sheet, official text as of 4 September 2009, and the Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet (slip 43)<ref name="sheet-6_1-first">Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV sheet, first copy ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; attachment Block6WithRebelFleetV.pdf, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1375528 Players Committee forum])</ref><ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_1-revised">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf#page=6 Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet], revised copy (PDF dated by 20 April 2010), page 6, slip 43. (Immune to Sense.) OR Lose 2 Force to cancel an attempt by Yoda or Obi-Wan to cancel your Interrupt or your just drawn weapon destiny. OR During your move phase, target any or all of your characters at one site to ‘transport’ (relocate) to an exterior or battleground site. Draw destiny. Use that much Force to ‘transport,’ or place this Interrupt in Lost Pile.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-43-Lana_Dobreed_Sacrifice.png]]) prints it. The slip prints slip number 43 at the bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Lana Dobreed & Sacrifice (Virtual Block 6) (Errata)]]): PC website card list, Virtual Block 6 list and Virtual master list, in every archived capture with game text, 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013<ref name="cl-1261_44">Players Committee website card list (Internet Archive captures): VBlock6Type (Virtual Block 6 list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 12 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142254/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 11 January 2013]; VMasterType (Virtual master list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 January 2013]. Later captures carry no game text.</ref>: “If your character’s forfeit was just reduced to 0, use 1 Force (free if forfeit reduced by a [Permanent Weapon] weapon) to restore it to normal. (Immune to Sense.) OR Lose 2 Force to cancel an attempt by Yoda or Obi-Wan to cancel your Interrupt or your just drawn weapon destiny. OR During your move phase, target any or all of your characters at one site to ‘transport’ (relocate) to an exterior or battleground site. Draw destiny. Use that much Force to ‘transport,’ or place Interrupt in Lost Pile.” '''What changed:''' One change: “this” before “Interrupt” is dropped. The Players Committee generated the website card list from its Holotable card data, so this wording is that data's transcription of the card; the Players Committee published it on its own website, so it is a version. Icons written out in words, straight single quotes and credit lines in the list are not changes; the text here draws the icons as the printed slips do. The list shows no slip image.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-D-lanadobreed&sacrifice-pre.gif]]), on the Players Committee's server by 25 February 2013<ref name="pc-img-date-Virtual6-Dark">Players Committee card image folder (<code>Virtual6-Dark/large/</code>), web-server directory listing sorted by date: every file last modified 25 February 2013, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034706/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual6-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A 18 August 2019] (Internet Archive); the file is byte-identical to today's.</ref>: “If your character’s forfeit was just reduced to 0, use 1 Force (free if forfeit reduced by a [Permanent Weapon] weapon) to restore it to normal. (Immune to Sense.) OR Lose 2 Force to cancel an attempt by Yoda or Obi-Wan to cancel your Interrupt or your just drawn weapon destiny. OR During your move phase, target any or all of your characters at one site to ‘transport’ (relocate) to an exterior or battleground site. Draw destiny. Use that much Force to ‘transport,’ or place this Interrupt in Lost Pile.” '''What changed:''' it prints the original release-sheet words again, word for word, undoing the card-list changes listed under PC-E1. The date is the bulk upload date of the whole image folder, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (versions ruling of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is a version at its upload date, and what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It prints the same slip number as the release-sheet slip (43).
